statement: Use Info log editor infrastructure through shared UI infrastructure (7 operators in bpy.ops.info): every member behaves as in Blender 5.3 and is covered by common tests instead of one test per operator.
notes: UI-infrastructure group row. Member operators (7): bpy.ops.info.report_copy = Copy Reports to Clipboard; bpy.ops.info.report_delete = Delete Reports; bpy.ops.info.report_replay = Replay Operators; bpy.ops.info.reports_display_update = Update Reports Display; bpy.ops.info.select_all = (De)select All; bpy.ops.info.select_box = Box Select; bpy.ops.info.select_pick = Select Report
